subtitle.en: Apache Kafka and the stream of events, 2010–2026

app_subtitle: Apache Kafka and the stream of events, 2010 – 2026
sources: J. Kreps, N. Narkhede and J. Rao, "Kafka: a Distributed Messaging System for Log Processing", NetDB 2011 (Athens, 12 June 2011)
J. Kreps, "The Log: What every software engineer should know about real-time data's unifying abstraction", LinkedIn Engineering, 16 December 2013; and I Heart Logs (O'Reilly, 2014)

Apache Kafka documentation (kafka.apache.org): Introduction, Design, Operations (consumer rebalance protocol), upgrade notes 3.0; release announcements 2.8.0, 3.3, 3.6.0, 3.9.0, 4.0.0, 4.2.0, 4.3.0; front page (Fortune 100 figure, October 2026)
Apache Incubator, Kafka project status page (incubation 4 July 2011, graduation 23 October 2012); ASF, "The Apache Software Foundation Announces Apache Kafka v1.0.0", 1 November 2017

Kafka Improvement Proposals KIP-500 (ZooKeeper replacement), KIP-679 (producer defaults), KIP-833 (KRaft production ready), KIP-405 (tiered storage), KIP-848 (consumer rebalance protocol), KIP-932 (queues)
N. Narkhede, "Exactly-once Semantics Are Possible: Here's How Kafka Does It", Confluent blog, 30 June 2017

LinkedIn Engineering: J. Lee and W. Wu, "How LinkedIn customizes Apache Kafka for 7 trillion messages per day" (8 October 2019); Northguard and Xinfra (June 2025), as reported by InfoQ and BigDATAwire
Confluent: "Apache Kafka Hits 1.1 Trillion Messages Per Day" (September 2015); press releases on Kafka Summit 2016, Confluent Cloud (May and November 2017) and the pricing of its IPO (23 June 2021)
B. Svingen, "Publishing with Apache Kafka at The New York Times", Confluent blog, September 2017
Fortune, "LinkedIn's Kafka creators launch Confluent" (6 November 2014); IBM announcement (8 December 2025) and Form 10-Q for the first quarter of 2026 (completion on 17 March 2026)

Announcements from Amazon (MSK preview, 28 November 2018; general availability, 30 May 2019), Microsoft (Event Hubs for Apache Kafka, 14 November 2018) and Google Cloud (Managed Service for Apache Kafka, 12 November 2024)
